tool_input.description: Quick scratch check of actual StringUtils behavior for ambiguous cases

result:
Mine is the only `*AgentTest.java` file in the project, and the full suite passes (43/43).

I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `StringUtils` across abbreviate/center/chomp/chop, compare, contains*, countMatches, defaults, deleteWhitespace, difference, endsWith*/equals*/startsWith*, indexOf*/lastIndexOf*, is*Blank/Empty/Numeric/Alpha/Case, join/joinWith, left/right/mid/pad, levenshtein distance, normalizeSpace, overlay, remove*/replace* (including the `replaceEach` vs `replaceEachRepeatedly` infinite-loop case), repeat, reverse/rotate, split family, strip/trim/truncate family, substring family, swapCase, unwrap/wrap, valueOf, and the public constants — with null, empty, and boundary cases throughout, asserting on returned values. All 43 test methods pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
